The '''Elrood system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route]] within the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]].<ref name="PotG3" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Elrood system was first mentioned in the [[1996]] roleplaying reference book ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''.<ref name="PotG3" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] campaign in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' portrayed the Empire uncovering information of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base in the Elrood system in the [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|battle]] of [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]]. The following level stated that it was [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the Elrood system, in contradiction to the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The game's databank entry for Hoth stated that the planet was in a [[Star system/Legends|system]] of the same [[Hoth system/Legends|name]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
